R1_reader.definition: big_core.read_shape: largest informational piece (geo_core.components, I > 1e-10) -> d = -log(I/I0) -> geo_core.geodesic (Isomap, factor 1.5) -> diameter D = max geodesic -> max-min landmarks (<= 220) -> ripser Vietoris-Rips H1 with the FULL filtration (no threshold; every H1 bar dies at a finite scale). rel = (death - birth)/D. HOLE = bar with rel > 0.4. holes = number of such bars. 'shape with a hole' = holes >= 1.
R1_reader.b2: NOT part of the reader. Declared consequence: the reader cannot see cavities (sphere-like); a torus is recognised through H1 only; the old geo_core b2 claims are neither confirmed nor refuted by it.

nulls_fresh.base: vacuum MI of the 24x24 box (pre_core.LatticeWalk, mirror edges, theta = 0.125, all interior link weights w = 0.3 = the start geometry of phase B), 576 sites
nulls_fresh.shuffle: 25 draws: off-diagonal values of the base MI randomly permuted (symmetric), diagonal kept
nulls_fresh.noise: 25 draws: log I ~ Gaussian with mean/std of log I (I > 1e-10) of the base, same fraction above the floor, the rest 0; diagonal = base diagonal
nulls_fresh.random_graph: 25 draws: random 4-regular graph on 576 nodes, one fermion mode per site, H = -A, half filling, MI of the ground state
nulls_fresh.random_state: 25 draws: Haar-random Gaussian state of 576 modes, 288 filled, one mode per site

known_shapes.torus_wilson: 16x16 torus, theta = 0.5, Wilson-like k-space coin r = 1 (pre_p4.vacuum_bloch), vacuum
known_shapes.line_x_hidden_circle: geo_core cylinder 36 (open line) x 18 (periodic hidden circle), vacuum, theta = 0.5
known_shapes.true_positive: holes >= 1 (every drawn shape has at least one non-contractible loop)

R1_reader.pass: false-positive rate (holes >= 1) <= 5 % in EACH null class (i.e. <= 1 of 25) AND 3/3 true positives
R1_reader.alternative_if_fail: ONE pre-declared alternative: bootstrap stability (big_core.read_shape_boot): a hole counts only if rel > 0.4 on the full data AND holes >= 1 on >= 8 of 10 random 70 % site subsamples (geodesic recomputed). Same pass rule. If it also fails: STOP, no big step.
predictions_not_graded: line x hidden circle: the hidden-circle H1 bar (the significant bar that dies first) has rel < 0.4, so the relative-to-diameter reader CANNOT see a small hidden circle; any hole it finds there is the long loop made by the sheet gluing at the open ends (rule shape), not the drawn hidden circle.
the hidden radius from the early-dying bar and the MDS circle are a different measurement (scale of a bar, not a hole count) and are not affected by the repair.
R1_reader.audit_of_old_geo_claims: apply the same H1-relative criterion to the stored geodesic matrices G0 of all lab/out/geo_space_{vac,quench}_*.npz (piece 0), and read_shape on the stored vacuum MI ('raw'); report which old b1 claims survive. Not graded.

R2_fake_mixing.setup: box n = 24 (mirror edges, all w = 1), lam = 0 (Bell minimal flow, also on walls: no teleport), N = 20000 surfers, cells 4x4 (36 cells, F = 0.000875), uniform start, omega0 = 1.8 theta, psi phase seed 101 (new), surfer seeds 201, 202, 203 (new); T = 200/theta ticks (theta = 0.125: 1600; theta = 0.0625: 3200), H sampled every 5 (0.5/theta) ticks. Curves averaged over the 3 surfer seeds before grading.
R2_fake_mixing.pass_per_theta: tau(M=1) >= 3 tau(M=16)  OR  [H_M1(T)/H_M1(0) > 0.10 AND H_M16(T)/H_M16(0) < 0.03]; tau = first time (H - F) <= (H0 - F)/e (pre_core.fit_tau); never -> inf
R2_fake_mixing.use_in_B: phase B uses the LARGEST theta in {0.125, 0.0625} that passes. If none passes: theta = 0.125, the Born-pinning exam is declared NOT meaningful and B is run for shape only.
